topic: Complete wiring: CDI, ignition and kill switch
statement: The 2011-2015 125 SX and 150 SX has no battery and one small harness around the CDI controller, which has an 18-pin plug. Pin 1, white/blue: ignition coil. Pin 2, brown: frame ground. Pins 6 and 7, black/red and white/red: alternator (the coil that powers the ignition), through a 4-pin plug at the engine. Pins 10 and 11, red and green: crankshaft position sensor, through the same 4-pin plug. Pin 5, black/yellow: kill switch, which grounds that wire to stop the engine. Pin 14, white/black, and pin 4, gray: the ignition curve connector; the two wires end in a single-pin plug pair, and joining or separating them selects the ignition curve. KTM's colour letters: bl black, br brown, bu blue, gn green, gr gray, or orange, pk pink, pu violet, rd red, wh white, ye yellow.
notes: Read from the wiring diagram by eye; check the diagram on the bike before cutting, splicing or back-probing. Which curve the joined and separated positions select is not shown on the diagram.

source.name: KTM repair manual wiring diagram sheets, 125/150 SX and 250 SX
